metadata.description: Calling all book worms, RTÉJr has the podcast for you!   On We Love Books,  we love talking about all things book-related!  Jam-packed with author interviews, writing tips, reviews and stories written by our very own listeners, We Love Books is a journey down the rabbit hole into the wonderful world of kids books.
metadata.author: RTÉjr
